senses.gloss: मृज् [cf. Gk. ὀ-μόργνυμι, ἀ-μέργω, ἀ-μέλγω; Lat. mulgere; Slav. mlěsti; Lith. mìlsti; Germ., melken, Milch; Eng. milk.]
मृज mfn. (ifc.) wiping off, removing, destroying (in अवद्य-म्˚), BhP.
मृज m. a kind of drum, L.
मृजा f. wiping, cleansing, washing, purification, ablution, Hariv.; Naiṣ.
a pure skin, clear complexion, Suśr.
मृजा—नगर n. N. of a town, Kṣitīś.
मृजा˚न्वय (मृजान्व्˚) mfn. possessing cleanliness, clean, Bhaṭṭ.
मृजा—वत् mfn. possessed of cl˚, MBh.
मृजा—वर्ण-बल-प्रद mfn. causing a clear complexion, colour and strength, Suśr.
मृजा—विहीन mfn. destitute of cl˚, uncleanly, unclean, R.
मृजित mfn. wiped, wiped off, removed, BhP.
मृज्य mfn. to be wiped or wiped off or removed, Bhaṭṭ.
